title: Turo a Ɛyerae Anadwo Biara
intro: Fa turo bi a ɛso yɛ frɔmfrɔm, a nnuaba a ɛbere ayɛ mu duru na nnua atenten atwa ho ahyia ho mfonini wɔ w’adwenem. Wɔn a wɔhwɛɛ so no susuwii sɛ wɔyɛ anifere, na wɔyɛɛ wɔn nnɔbae ho nhyehyɛe wɔ nnɔnhwerew a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn ansa na ade asa no mu, a na wɔn a wohia mmoa no ani nnye ho. Nanso na Nea ɔnna da no wɔ nhyehyɛe afoforo ma wɔn adom a ahintaw no. So wubetumi asusuw hena na ogyina kɔkɔbɔ asɛm yi akyi a efi Kur’aan mu?
clues: Bere bi na yɛwɔ turo bi a ɛso yɛ frɔmfrɔm na ɛdɔɔso araa ma ɛbɛyɛɛ wɔn a wɔretwam nyinaa anibere.
Wɔ yɛn nhyehyɛe mu no, yɛbɔɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho aseresɛm anɔpatutuutu, na yɛpaee mu kae sɛ wɔremma ɔkra biara a ohia no kwan mma ɔnkɔ mu saa da no.
Ná yɛyɛ nnipa a yɛwɔ adefo, na na yɛn koma afuw wɔ hokwan ahorow a ahiafo a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia no wɔ no ho.
Bere a otwa a na yɛpɛ sɛ yebenya no duu hɔ no, yɛkɔɔ yɛn turo no nkyɛn na yehui sɛ adan amamfõ a ayɛ tuntum anadwo biako pɛ.
Mmara bi a ɛyɛ hu baa mu, na wɔannyaw biribiara gye nsõ wɔ baabi a bere bi na nnuaba a abere akuwakuw asɛn hɔ no.
Yɛn anansesɛm no yɛ kɔkɔbɔ a emu yɛ den a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Kur’aan mu, faako a wonim yɛn sɛ turo no wuranom a wɔde adɔe siee ahiafo.
